title: A full cache evicts the least recently used leaf
notes: The cache holds 12 tokens. After A and B finish, C splits A's edge and the cache is full. D needs one slot. The least recently used leaf that nobody is using is "mat" (last used at time 2), so it goes; C is using rug, and B's "ate the ball" was used later.
ops: the cat sat on the mat
the cat sat on the rug
